campaign_intent.audience: Women 45+ with dry, mature skin and fair to medium skin tones (persona: Linda, 56) who have tried many foundations and fear the wrong shade, a cakey look and lines
campaign_intent.conversion_goal: Warm cold traffic with the listicle, convert on the product page and checkout, raise AOV with four post-purchase offers; every package is a subscription

approved_claims: goes on white and adapts to fair to medium skin tones as you blend
made not to settle into fine lines (hedged until the 6-hour wear panel)
skincare-infused foundation with PDRN, peptides and Volufiline
forbidden_claims: any percentage or study result before the consumer study
reviews presented as the stick's own (the reviews are the liquid foundation's and say so)
copy_rules: before/after images are labelled AI illustrations
subscription terms are stated next to every buy button: price today, renewal price and interval, how to cancel
the manufacturing spec stays confidential: no percentages, suppliers or process
